title: Heterogeneous graph learning prioritises candidate multi-target mechanisms of Guizhi Tang (revision v2.0)
description: Revision release accompanying the Scientific Reports manuscript 'Heterogeneous graph learning prioritises candidate multi-target mechanisms of Guizhi Tang'. Contains the curated heterogeneous knowledge graph (189 nodes, 1,322 structural edges, 154 compound-disease labels), the graph builder, four link-prediction models (MLP, GCN, R-GCN, HetGNN), leakage-free evaluation and controls (degree-only and shared-target baselines, label permutation, edge ablations, cold-start), real KEGG/Enrichr enrichment with annotation-density controls, the AutoDock Vina docking pipeline with decoy comparisons, all result tables and publication figures.
